title: ze_PC
description:
This is a rat map set inside a desktop PC. Players start on the desk behind the computer and enter it through the holes on the back of the power supply. From there, the path continues across the HDD and SSD, through the graphics card cooler, out across the motherboard slots, and up onto the CPU cooler.

After that, players enter directly into the processor itself, where the first fight with the CPU Boss takes place. Once defeated, players move to the RAM modules, where the map culminates in the final battle with the Fan Boss.

ALU/CPU Boss: A processor where zombies input math problems in binary, and humans must quickly calculate the result to step off the active wires in time and avoid taking damage.

Fan Boss: Destroy the fan before time runs out and all RAM sticks drop from their slots, while dodging flying dust and watching out for individual modules that unexpectedly fall away during the fight.
